Last year's steeplechase result was reversed when John Dear just held off the Dance finish to score a popular win. (Our 8:52.0 chaser, John Bicourt, opted for the mile, as did our sub 9:20 man Alan Black.) Perhaps some of the massive mile field would surprise themselves if they tackled this event next year.
For the short legs Hart, O'Connor, Dance and Diprose look well placed, with the last two places to be scrambled for by Bicourt, O'Hara, Piotrowski, Cross and Kerr.
Last year we had lost the title, but this year, although without the services of Fairclough and Dance (both injured), we thought, ran and won like a real team for the first time.
